prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions frequently overestimated positive impact for neutral or negative changes, but underestimated large winning tests.
Sign-in hint (5 wins), home wait_info (5 wins), home new_flow (2 wins), and finish new_screen (2 wins) changes can be helpful, though many showed no clear effect.
Choose_path copy, choose_path hint, choose_path layout, choose_path redesign, finish new_flow, and adoption new_flow changes can be helpful (1 win each), though other tests showed no clear effect or negative impact.
Sign-in reorder changes proved consistently harmful across agreeing tests.
Finish copy, home notification, and adoption hint changes showed no clear effect across agreeing tests with no wins.
Evidence remains thin for single-test categories (adoption incentive, layout, new_screen; choose_path new_flow; finish hint, notification; home redesign), while adoption redesign tests lean negative overall.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Interactive Desktop Pet Command Center Screen: Adds a dedicated interactive command screen at the end of onboarding showing users how to talk to, summon, and hide their desktop pet. (why: Support receives multiple inquiries after onboarding regarding how to interact with, hide, or trigger actions for their desktop pet.)
1: [home, new_flow] Desktop Pet Render Prep Companion Flow: Introduces a background preparation activity stream with interactive companion mascot tips while desktop pet files assemble. (why: Home wait_info and home new_flow tests have proven to be the most consistent win categories in historical tests.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Multi-Device Account Sync Safety Hint: Displays a prominent security and pet data persistence banner reassurance directly on the sign-in screen. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing back in. Sign-in hints have 5 historical wins.)
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Render Status Progress Time Estimate Stream: Adds an estimated time countdown bar and live status updates during desktop render generation. (why: Home wait_info features have a proven track record (5 wins) in alleviating uncertainty during long background creation steps.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Existing Pet Data Preservation Hint: Adds explicit reassurance that signing into an existing account restores previously created desktop pets. (why: Multiple user support tickets report confusion around pet state after account sign-in.)
5: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Quick Interactions Mastery Screen: Adds a post-onboarding quick-reference screen highlighting essential desktop pet hotkeys and tray options. (why: Finish new_screen changes show strong historical performance (2 wins) and directly solve post-onboarding confusion support issues.)
